senses.en_definition: To work or operate; to serve a purpose or perform a role.

messages.en: Mum, this washing machine's really noisy. Should we get a new one?
It still works. The clothes come out clean too. No need to buy a new one just yet.
Okay, I'll get someone to come and take a look first.
There are only three of us in our group. Shall we join up with Farah's group?
Sounds good. I've already asked Farah, and she's agreed. We can work out who does what together later.
I don't want to argue over something this small.
I've calmed down too. Let's talk it through calmly, okay?
Are we going to the beach tomorrow?
Depends on the weather. If it rains, we'll just stay home.
